test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Sukrit purchased an item for ₹650 and sold it at a profit of 26%. At what price (in ₹) did Sukrit sell the item?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of the item = ₹650

Profit percentage = 26%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) + Profit

Profit = (Profit Percentage × Cost Price) / 100

**Calculation:**

Profit = (26 × 650) / 100

⇒ Profit = 169

Selling Price (SP) = 650 + 169

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = 819

**The selling price of the item is ₹819.**
